name: switching to the next box parks the workspace with its shell, and switching back finds it there
about: Run by both consoles, each pressing its own binding for each step's command: cli/internal/tui/parity_test.go and desktop/src/parity_tests.rs. Each step is a registry command ID (cli/internal/console/commands.go), run from the workspace's focused pane; expect is what the workspace on screen looks like after it, and which row of the list its box is on (box). The first two rows are running boxes.
